user.title: DHL login
user.description:
1. Open this link in a browser and log in with your DHL account:

[Open DHL login]({login_url})

2. After login the browser tries to open the DHL app. Open the developer tools (F12) → Network/Console first; copy the URL starting with `dhllogin://de.deutschepost.dhl/login?code=`.

3. Paste the full URL here (valid only a few minutes).
